🌍 Guest onboarding — all LSH languages

Fires on hotel.checkin. The Code node renders the welcome + house info in en/pl/de/fr/es/it/uk ($json.localized, and $json.allLanguages as one block). No LLM needed.

NEXT: send $json.localized[guestLanguage] (or $json.allLanguages) to the guest via SMS/WhatsApp/email/in-room display. City & portal are pulled from LSH config at build time.
